question: When my speed reaches 4 as a result of start your engines, do I count as having max speed?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: a player has max speed if their speed is 4.
expected.answer: A player “has max speed” if their speed is 4.

source.license: Reproduced from the official Wizards of the Coast card-ruling text distributed for use by Magic: The Gathering tools and reference sites; this project already commits and serves this exact rulings corpus in production (see committedDataPath) as its card-ruling retrieval source.
source.questionAuthorship: The question is this project's own natural-language phrasing of a scenario the cited card's official ruling directly answers; the answer is the ruling's text, verbatim.

whyHard: Speed is not a card property, so players do not know what counts as having max speed.
